blindSummary: A 2023 law makes it criminal trespass to refuse to leave a facility not matching one's sex assigned at birth — after being told to leave by a government employee — in buildings owned by the state/province. It produced what is believed to be the first arrest under a state/province bathroom law (March 2025, at the state capitol, held ~24 hours; charges later dismissed on a technicality — a mixed-leaning-positive institutional response). The state/province stopped issuing driver's licences with corrected gender markers and treats "misrepresentation" as potential fraud; local and national LGBT-rights organisations issued travel advisories naming this state/province. Physical safety is comparatively better than the law suggests: 3.7 killings per 100k trans women/yr, below the average among the country's strictest-law states/provinces. Local risk is below the country-wide average.
